name: Integer Division and Overflow Semantics
description: Rules for integer division truncation direction (floor vs towards-zero), signed overflow (UB vs wrap vs auto-promote), and modulo signs.
when_to_retrieve: When translating integer division (e.g. C++ a/b to Python a//b or JS Math.floor(a/b))
When modulo arithmetic involves negative operands
When integer values approach 32-bit or 64-bit boundaries
when_not_to_retrieve: When operating strictly on floating point decimal numbers
retrieval_guidance: In Python, -7 // 2 is -4 (floor towards -infinity). In C++, -7 / 2 is -3 (truncation towards zero). In JavaScript, -7 / 2 is -3.5 (float). Modulo -7 % 2 is 1 in Python, but -1 in C++ and JavaScript.
